# Download WhatEverFi

The WhatEverFi desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) and mobile (iPhone, iPad, Android) apps are coming soon. Until then, use the web version:

- [Web](https://app.whateverfi.com)

Self-hosting? WhatEverFi is built on the open-source [elie222/rakazo](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo) engine (Apache-2.0). Its [releases page](https://github.com/elie222/rakazo/releases) has the upstream desktop builds, which carry the upstream branding. See the [self-hosting guide](https://whateverfi.com/self-hosted-ai-agent/).
